_comment: Copy to <home>/config.json (next to the app/ folder). This is the ONE file that differs per machine -- laptop, office network, or AWS.

site._comment: Where THIS hub listens. 127.0.0.1 = this machine only; 0.0.0.0 = reachable from the network / AWS. url_prefix (e.g. /testhub) lets the hub share a domain with the app under test behind an ALB/nginx path rule -- see docs/AWS.md. behind_proxy trusts X-Forwarded-* (set ONLY behind your own proxy).

target._comment: The website UNDER TEST. Empty url = the hub's own /demo/ page (works fully offline). version is stamped onto every run and powers the per-version charts.
target.name: My application

paths._comment: Empty = <home>/data. Holds tests/, results/, db.sqlite3. Never deleted by app upgrades.

maintenance._comment: >0 prunes run ARTIFACTS (videos/traces) older than N days at startup. DB history and charts are always kept.
